notes.title: Synchronicity - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Synchronicity is finally released!
I've had a lot of fun making, playtesting and improving this game over the years and the day has finally come to release it into the wild! Thanks to all the folks who played with me and gave valuable feedback!

I've made the decission to release it for free! But if you like it and can afford it: consider checking out the Supporter Pack <3, or leaving a nice review :)

I'm looking forward to playing some exciting matches against you all and hear your feedback, either in the forums or on discord.

Cheers
Simon

notes.title: Synchronicity has a Demo!
notes.content:
I've just released the public Demo for Synchronicity <3 

[h3]What is in the Demo[/h3]
The Demo is full featured and contains all the game currently has to offer. Once the game is released the Demo will be more restrictive, but for now you basically get the full game. 

[h3]Community[/h3]
Over the last months I've tested the game with a lot of help from friends and the community to iron out the kinks (thank you <3) and its now ready to get more eyeballs on it :)

Feel free to tell me what you think or if you find any bugs! 
Use the Steam Forums or the [url=https://discord.gg/YCDpEBUz4T]Discord channel[/url] to get in touch with me and the other players!

Have fun!

Cheers,
Simon
